# Map of Large Agent Systems

> An interactive map of the organizations, projects, and programs working on Large Agent Systems (LAS) safety — decentralised systems of AI agents with high-speed, complex interactions.

## Resource Pages

- [Map](https://www.map.largeagentsystems.org/map): An interactive visual overview of key organizations, programs, and projects in the Large Agent Systems safety space

This map and its underlying code are provided by AISafety.com under an MIT licence.
